scientific.integrity: The result is derived from the exact second-moment recursion of the published KGSM update on an orthonormal two-equation system. Schur stability is classified by the cubic Jury criterion, with the only nontrivial global positivity condition certified by exact rational Bernstein coefficients.
limitations: The exact frontier is proved only for the orthonormal two-equation system with uniform independent row sampling.
No universal boundary for nonorthogonal matrices is claimed.
Mean-square instability is distinct from an almost-sure divergence claim.
The signed-mean blind-spot interval is classified explicitly for the unsmoothed case beta equal to zero.

title: Exact mean-square stability frontier and a signed-mean blind spot in KGSM
